services.name: July Fishing
services.desc: Coastal Halibut grounds can be 1 ½ to 2 hours from boat ramp and the season is generally the beginning of May to the end of June. Salmon season is generally from the end of June to September, depending on fishing quota. Sightseeing rates $600.00 for 1-6 people for 4 hours (no site seeing during fishing dates) Bottom fishing starts 2nd Saturday in March and goes to October 15th call to book bottom

includes: All gear, bait, and ice to keep your catch fresh are supplied
Life jackets and personal flotation devices for everyone
blurb: Guests join a fishing boat charter on Point "B", a 2022 3025 Kingfisher equipped for Salmon, Halibut, Lingcod, and bottom fishing. The captain is US Coast Guard Certified with 30 years of fishing experience and is also a trauma nurse. The boat is limited to 4 passengers for comfort and safety, with a fully enclosed bathroom and diesel heater on board.
